inputs.prompt: Edit this drone image. The nose is at the top of the image. Change only the front end of the fuselage at the top: make its leading edge narrower and more rounded, a slimmer and softer nose. Keep the rest of the body outline, the top cover panels and parting lines, the arm roots and the existing camera installation unchanged. Keep everything else exactly the same: the strict orthographic top view, the arms beyond their roots, the motors, the two-blade propellers and their angles, the colours and the plain light background.
inputs.negative_prompt: flat schematic, line drawing, collage, text, labels, logo, cropped rotor, disconnected arm, extra rotor, perspective camera, V-shaped propeller, blades at an acute angle, single-blade propeller, missing blade, unequal blades, extra components, new modules, camera at the tail, dark module at the tail
